result.summary: Independently re-verified every claim in commit 7a2217f4 / handoff step-01-code-designer-rework1.json by reading source directly, not by trusting the self-report. (1) lib/letflow/instances.ex:53 read directly: `def get_by_id(id, opts) when is_list(opts)` returns `{:ok, %InstanceProjection{}}` via `Repo.get(InstanceProjection, id, prefix: prefix)` (nil -> {:error, :not_found}) -- confirmed exactly as claimed. (2) lib/letflow/event_store/instance_projection.ex:134 read directly: `field(:current_nodes, Letflow.EventStore.JSONArray, default: [])`; moduledoc lines 34-58 state verbatim 'current_nodes is a jsonb column holding a JSON array ... active token positions', distinguishing it from variables/error_detail's JSON objects -- confirmed. (3) lib/letflow/engine.ex read directly at all cited sites: line 1169 (`insert_instance_projection/8`'s attrs map, `current_nodes: current_node_ids`, feeding InstanceProjection.insert_changeset/2 at instance creation), line 1371 (`interpret_create_result/6`'s returned map, `current_nodes: current_node_ids`), line 2763 (`reconcile_projection/5`'s attrs map, `current_nodes: Enum.map(final_instance_state.tokens, & &1.node_id)`) -- and independently grepped all 7 occurrences of `current_nodes` in engine.ex, confirming `reconcile_projection/5` is called from two live transition call sites (lines 2008, 2453) in addition to being defined at 2754 -- i.e. genuinely populated at creation and on every subsequent transition/completion, not merely at one call site. All claims confirmed, no discrepancy. (4) Read the design's updated §4.1 outcome 1, §4.3 steps 1-2, and §9 OQ-1 directly: §4.1 adds current_nodes as an explicitly-labeled 'Corroborating instance_state check (OQ-1-resolved addition, not a replacement)' alongside (not instead of) the task-list query, correctly reasoned since AC1's literal wording requires the task-list mechanism; §4.3 step 2 now states current_nodes as the 'primary mechanism ... superseding the task-list-inference workaround', with the risk-evaluation task_assigned/PENDING check explicitly kept 'for its own distinct evidence (that a real task row was created and assigned to the correct role; current_nodes alone does not prove a task exists)' -- exactly the claimed split. §9 OQ-1 is rewritten to 'RESOLVED (independently confirmed this session by direct read, not deferred)' with the same three citations and an explicit no-knock-on-change statement for §2/§3/§6/§7/§8. (5) OQ-2 (R-Co-corpus fact for risk_rating's positive value, confirmed unreachable per §0.3's ISS-0393 finding, non-blocking since any non-'unacceptable' string satisfies the condition) and OQ-3 (page_size:100 margin check, already self-answered as sufficient for this requirement's own bounded scenarios, flagged only for future awareness) both meet this session's no-silent-deferral standard: each is either genuinely unreachable material or already-resolved-in-its-own-bullet, not a live ambiguity pushed onto ELIXIR-DEV. Independently diffed d93f0d22..7a2217f4 on the design file: the only sections touched are §4.1 (outcome 1), §4.3 (steps 1-2), and §9 (OQ-1 + closing paragraph) -- confirmed no other section needed a matching change: §2's :blocked/:no_task_of_type additions do not depend on how 'paused at node X' is verified; §3's graph shapes are unaffected; §6's report format and §7's follow-up issue text are unaffected; §8's AC map still cites the same sections (only the internal verification mechanism within those sections strengthened, not the AC-to-section mapping). (6) Re-scanned every code fence in the full file for `defmodule`/`defstruct`: zero matches (grep -n confirmed). Checks 1-8 from the prior FAIL pass (fixtures real, no native quorum primitive, task_assigned cannot express absence, no existing BLOCKED disposition, REQ-199 done + sequential-dispatch caveat accurate, ISS-0389/ISS-0393 referenced not duplicated, no implementation code, all 6 ACs mapped) were untouched by this rework and do not need re-verification per this task's own scoping. The prior Check-9 defect is fully resolved with no new discrepancy introduced. Design is APPROVED, no ambiguity remains for ELIXIR-DEV to guess at.
